new.text: Among conventional machine-learning approaches, \citet{rahman2022rainfall} developed a fusion-based system for smart-city rainfall prediction that combines multiple classifiers with fuzzy logic, reporting improvements in prediction accuracy in their study.

More recently, \citet{latif2023assessing} compared statistical, machine-learning and deep-learning approaches to rainfall prediction and concluded that machine learning performed well across climates and timescales, with LSTM models among the most effective.
